dose_display.rule: Use the low end first; poor sleep or high habitual caffeine can downgrade suitability.

es.title: Cafeína: puede mejorar el rendimiento en contextos específicos

en.title: Caffeine: may improve performance in selected contexts

en.limit: If you sleep poorly or already consume a lot of caffeine, Vitami downgrades or avoids this recommendation.
